title: Whittling Set 30 Pieces – 6 Knives And 6 Chisels
seo_title: Whittling Set 30 Pieces – 6 Knives, 6 Chisels, Cut-Resistant Gloves
seo_description: Whittling set with 30 pieces: 6 knives, 6 small chisels, blade guards, leather strop, polishing compound, sandpaper, a piece of wood to practice on and cut-resistant gloves in a bag.
descriptionHtml:
You're looking for the right knife in the drawer again

A dull knife from the kitchen cabinet, a sharp blade with no cover and nothing to protect your hand if it slips – whittling becomes more hassle than relaxation before you've even gotten started.

30 pieces gathered in one bag

The whittling set has 6 knives and 6 small chisels for different cuts, a blade guard for each blade, a leather strop and polishing compound to keep the edge sharp, sandpaper, a piece of wood to practice on and cut-resistant gloves – all in a bag with a zipper.

Features

  • The gloves protect when the knife slips – cut-resistant gloves are included in the set.
  • The right tool for every cut – 6 knives and 6 small chisels in different shapes.
  • The blades stay sharp – a leather strop and polishing compound come with the set to bring the edge back.
  • Practice before you start on the real thing – a piece of wood to practice on is included.
  • Everything in one place – 30 pieces in a bag with a zipper.

Sharp tools. Use the gloves.
